status.description: Outcome of the delegated single-turn worker task.

summary.description: Concise summary (at most 5 sentences) of what was implemented and verified.

files_modified.description: Relative paths of files created, updated, or deleted.

notes_for_orchestrator.description: Any essential context Antigravity needs to decide merge or rework.
